# Game Idea: Shadow Dash

A side‑scrolling endless runner rendered on an HTML canvas. The player’s silhouette runs automatically; clicking or tapping makes it jump, and a second tap makes it slide. Obstacles (spikes, walls, gaps) appear randomly. **Lose condition:** colliding with any obstacle or falling into a gap ends the game. The goal is to survive as long as possible while collecting glowing orbs for points.

1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio assets (place your files in an 'assets' folder)
7:   const sounds = {
8:     jump: new Audio('assets/jump.wav'),
9:     slide: new Audio('assets/slide.wav'),
10:     orb: new Audio('assets/orb.wav'),
11:     death: new Audio('assets/death.wav')
12:   };
13:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
14:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);
15:   const GROUND = H - 50;
16:   const PLAYER = {
17:     w: 30,
18:     h: 50,
19:     x: 80,
20:     y: GROUND - 50,
21:     vy: 0,
22:     jumpV: -12,
23:     gravity: 0.6,
24:     sliding: false,
25:     slideTimer: 0,
26:     slideDuration: 15,
27:     onGround() {return this.y >= GROUND - this.h;}
28:   };
29:   const obstacles = [];
30:   const orbs = [];
31:   let frame = 0, score = 0, gameOver = false;
32: 
33:   // Input handling: click/tap toggles jump or slide
34:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
35:     if (gameOver) return reset();
36: if (PLAYER.onGround()) {
37:           PLAYER.vy = PLAYER.jumpV;
38:           sounds.jump.currentTime = 0; sounds.jump.play();
39: } else if (!PLAYER.sliding) {
40:         PLAYER.sliding = true;
41:         PLAYER.slideTimer = PLAYER.slideDuration;
42:         PLAYER.h = 30; // shorter height while sliding
43:         sounds.slide.currentTime = 0; sounds.slide.play();
44:       }
45:   });
46: 
47:   function reset() {
48:     obstacles.length = 0;
49:     orbs.length = 0;
50:     PLAYER.y = GROUND - 50;
51:     PLAYER.vy = 0;
52:     PLAYER.h = 50;
53:     PLAYER.sliding = false;
54:     frame = 0;
55:     score = 0;
56:     gameOver = false;
57:     loop();
58:   }
59: 
60:   function spawnObstacle() {
61:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
62:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
63:     obstacles.push({x: W + w, y: GROUND - h, w, h});
64:   }
65: 
66:   function spawnOrb() {
67:     const r = 8;
68:     const y = GROUND - 80 - Math.random() * 100;
69:     orbs.push({x: W + r, y, r});
70:   }
71: 
72:   function update() {
73:     frame++;
74:     // Player physics
75:     PLAYER.vy += PLAYER.gravity;
76:     PLAYER.y += PLAYER.vy;
77:     if (PLAYER.y > GROUND - PLAYER.h) {
78:       PLAYER.y = GROUND - PLAYER.h;
79:       PLAYER.vy = 0;
80:     }
81:     if (PLAYER.sliding) {
82:       PLAYER.slideTimer--;
83:       if (PLAYER.slideTimer <= 0) {
84:         PLAYER.sliding = false;
85:         PLAYER.h = 50;
86:       }
87:     }
88:     // Move obstacles & orbs
89:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= 4);
90:     orbs.forEach(o => o.x -= 4);
91:     // Remove off‑screen
92:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
93:     while (orbs.length && orbs[0].x + orbs[0].r < 0) orbs.shift();
94:     // Spawn logic
95:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
96:     if (frame % 200 === 0) spawnOrb();
97:     // Collision detection
98:     for (const o of obstacles) {
99: if (PLAYER.x < o.x + o.w && PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w > o.x &&
100:            PLAYER.y < o.y + o.h && PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h > o.y) {
101:          gameOver = true;
102:          sounds.death.currentTime = 0; sounds.death.play();
103: 
104:     }
105:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
106:       const o = orbs[i];
107:       const dx = (PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w/2) - o.x;
108:       const dy = (PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h/2) - o.y;
109:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < o.r + Math.min(PLAYER.w, PLAYER.h)/2) {
110:         score += 10;
111:         sounds.orb.currentTime = 0; sounds.orb.play();
112:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
113:       }
114:     }
115:     // Falling off ground (gap) – simplified as y > GROUND
116:     if (PLAYER.y > GROUND) gameOver = true;
117:     if (!gameOver) score++;
118:   }
119: 
120:   function draw() {
121:   // Background gradient
122:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
123:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a237e'); // dark blue top
124:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d47a1'); // darker bottom
125:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
126:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
127:   // Ground gradient
128:   const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND, 0, H);
129:   groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#37474f');
130:   groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#263238');
131:   ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
132:   ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);
133:   // Player silhouette with rounded corners
134:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
135:   const radius = 5;
136:   ctx.beginPath();
137:   ctx.moveTo(PLAYER.x + radius, PLAYER.y);
138:   ctx.lineTo(PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w - radius, PLAYER.y);
139:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w, PLAYER.y, PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w, PLAYER.y + radius);
140:   ctx.lineTo(PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h - radius);
141:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h, PLAYER.x + PLAYER.w - radius, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h);
142:   ctx.lineTo(PLAYER.x + radius, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h);
143:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(PLAYER.x, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h, PLAYER.x, PLAYER.y + PLAYER.h - radius);
144:   ctx.lineTo(PLAYER.x, PLAYER.y + radius);
145:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(PLAYER.x, PLAYER.y, PLAYER.x + radius, PLAYER.y);
146:   ctx.fill();
147:   // Obstacles with simple style
148:   ctx.fillStyle = '#f44336';
149:   obstacles.forEach(o => {
150:     // Draw as filled rectangle with a dark outline
151:     ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
152:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#b71c1c';
153:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
154:     ctx.strokeRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
155:   });
156:   // Orbs with glow effect
157:   orbs.forEach(o => {
158:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r);
159:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#b2ff59');
160:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#33691e');
161:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
162:     ctx.beginPath();
163:     ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
164:     ctx.fill();
165:   });
166:   // Score / Game Over (retain original styling but reposition)
167:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:   ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
169:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
170:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
171:   if (gameOver) {
172:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
173:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
176:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
177:     ctx.fillText('Game Over - Click to Restart', W/2, H/2);
178:   }
179: }
180: 
181: 
182:   }
183: 
184:   function loop() {
185:     if (!gameOver) update();
186:     draw();
187:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:   }
189:   // expose for debugging
190:   window.gameReset = reset;
191:   loop();
192: })();

(End of file - total 192 lines)
</content>
